verified_facts.text: Guestroom design is inspired by the minimalist style of Suzhou architecture, with crisp black lines on white.
verified_facts.excerpt: The guestroom design is inspired by the unique and minimalist style of Suzhou architecture of crisp black lines on white, defining shapes and silhouettes in its utmost simplicity.

verified_facts.text: Gusu View rooms show lush greenery and garden architecture, while city view rooms show the urban energy of The China Central Place.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Gusu View rooms in Suzhou showcase lush greenery and the iconic garden architecture, while city view rooms highlight the sleek urban energy of The China Central Place, Suzhou.

verified_facts.text: Biao Xia, the Chinese restaurant, is rooted in Huaiyang cuisine and blends seasonal seafood with carefully chosen ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooted in the profound traditions of Huaiyang cuisine, masterfully blends seasonal seafood with meticulously chosen ingredients

verified_facts.text: Biao Xia is listed as a Michelin Guide restaurant selection for 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Restaurant Selection Michelin Guide 2026 - Biao Xia

verified_facts.text: Biao Xia is named after the highest peak of the Violet Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named after the highest peak of the Violet Garden

verified_facts.text: Feng Pan Ting is a Chinese tea venue where guests enjoy Pingtan performance and traditional tea ceremonies with afternoon tea in a Jiangnan-inspired setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy Pingtan rhythm and traditional tea ceremonies as you savor afternoon tea in a Jiangnan-inspired setting.

verified_facts.text: Alkanna Bar has a hidden wine cellar.
verified_facts.excerpt: It features a hidden wine cellar for a full sensory experience

verified_facts.text: Alkanna is the international restaurant on the first floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the first floor, Alkanna offers international cuisine in a space that blends modern chic with timeless elegance

verified_facts.text: A Private Cellar experience pairs seasonal bespoke dishes with Chinese wines in a hidden private wine cellar, with discreet sommelier service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in a hidden private wine cellar, this exclusive Chinese wine pairing feast offers a luxe secluded venue for intimate gatherings.

verified_facts.text: The Rice Wine Odyssey pairs Huaiyang cuisine with aged rice wine, with handcrafted rice wine welcome drinks and DIY rice wine cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: This rice wine feast blends exquisite Huaiyang cuisine with mellow aged rice wine

verified_facts.text: A private night tour of the Humble Administrator's Garden is offered to guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: this private tour pairs Humble Administrator’s Garden’s millennia‑old world‑heritage legacy with The Ritz‑Carlton, Suzhou’s refined luxury.

verified_facts.text: An experience explores the H+ Art Museum, designed by Tadao Ando and within walking distance, with private guided tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: explores Suzhou’s new landmark H+ Art Museum designed by Tadao Ando. Within walking distance, guests enjoy private guided tours

verified_facts.text: Nearby sights include the Lingering Garden and Humble Administrator's Garden, both UNESCO sites, as well as Pingjiang Historic Street and Shantang Street.
verified_facts.excerpt: stroll near the serene Lingering Garden and Humble Administrator’s Garden, both UNESCO sites, or explore Pingjiang Historic Street and Shantang Street

verified_facts.text: The indoor swimming pool and the fitness centre are on the LG2 floor; the fitness centre has saunas and steam rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The locker rooms are thoughtfully appointed with luxurious shower facilities, saunas, steam rooms, and premium amenities

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is on the 18th floor with panoramic views of the ancient cityscape and Suzhou's garden architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton suite is located on the 18th floor of the hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide airport shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Subway Line 2 and Suzhou Railway Station are listed as nearby transport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Subway Station Subway Line 2 Train Station Suzhou Railway Station

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Ritz-Carlton, Suzhou.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast at Alkanna is available for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Alkanna for a fee.

verified_facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz Kids Safari Adventures programme includes an night safari and a specially curated activity for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: an enchanting night safari, delightful Ritz Kids amenities, and a specially curated activity for the little ones.

verified_facts.text: The Club Lounge on the 5th floor has an oriental-inspired outdoor garden setting.
